title: Review
subtitle: Everything that waits on you, art and audio. Only you approve, request changes or sign off a listening; agents can ask and answer, never decide.
inbox.label: Inbox
inbox.empty: Nothing to review. When an agent submits frames or asks for a review, it appears here.
detail.label: Selected item
detail.none: Pick an item to see what changed, what the agent asked and how to decide.
detail.unknown: That item is not in the inbox any more.
ask.title: Agent request
cmp.title: Before and after
cmp.root: This is the first revision of the frame, so there is nothing to compare with.
cmp.identical: No pixel differs from the previous revision (metadata or review only).
cmp.sizeDiffers: The two revisions have different sizes, so no pixel comparison is possible.
cmp.summary: {count} pixels changed, inside a {w}×{h} box at {x},{y}.
rev.title: Revisions and who made them
thread.title: Thread on revision {revision}
decide.title: Your decision
decide.humanOnly: Only this page can approve or request changes. No agent tool can.
decide.notHead: You are looking at an older revision. Decisions apply to the latest one, r{head}.
decide.placeholder: What should change, or why you approve
decide.conflict: A newer revision exists; reloaded. Look again before deciding.
audio.noWaveFile: No waveform without a master file.
audio.humanOnly: You sign what you heard on this exact master. An agent cannot hear, so no agent tool can sign.
audio.stale: The master changed after the last sign-off. Listen again.
audio.notePlaceholder: What you heard: seam, head and tail, mono
audio.changed: The master changed since you loaded it; reloaded. Listen again.
